motion_rule: he shoulders down the alley all clip while the world flies into him: slips and the lemming come at the lens every beat and burst on his coat; the camera tracks alongside him, lockers sweeping past, his face to the lens; his head half the frame; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; the tall frame filled, no bars
character: a shaggy musk ox with a heavy fringed coat and broad horns, muzzle clear of his hooves
second_characters: ONE lemming courier working the lens, big in frame, firing slips into his coat
props: ONE plastic card frozen into his chest fur from the first beat; A SWARM of paper slips building a drift on his back
prop_continuity: the card stays in his chest fur until 6.80; the drift grows to 8.25, slips flying off the flanks on the way, then off at once
environment: a parcel alley at noon, lockers and postbox towers to the roof hard both sides a hoof away, no far wall
light_events: sun between the lockers whips bright bars across his face every beat, cold rim one side, warm kick the other

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 3.6 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: pod-PEE-sok, TSE-ly, sug-ROP, ZNA-yu, da-YUT, pla-CHU — stress CHU, he pays, never PLA-chu meaning weeping
audio.pacing: 0.45-3.45, 4.25-5.65 and 6.45-7.55 each one breath; after 7.55 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaw drops wide and his lips shape every syllable, brows and jaw alive, muzzle clear of hooves and props, never a voice over
audio.sfx: alley wind, locker doors, paper slapping fur, the drift thumping at 8.25

timeline.a: he shoulders into the alley, drift on his back, card in his chest fur
he drives his chest through a wall of slips flying at the lens and they plaster his chest and shoulders, muzzle clear
he swings his horns and takes a locker door open across them without breaking stride
he hauls his shoulder along the locker row and rakes a sheaf of slips onto his coat
he cuts hard across the alley into the far lockers, muzzle to the lens, the drift shedding slips sideways past it
the lemming sprints across the lens flank to flank firing slips into his coat as he ploughs on
he ploughs on and shrugs one flank clean, slips peeling off past the lens
he bodies a locker bank open with his shoulder, ploughing down the row
he hooks the card up out of his fur on one horn tip, driving on, slips streaming off past the lens
he drives his chest at the lens, the card showing through the fur
he rips the card out of his chest and waves it past the lens beside his muzzle, ploughing on
he shoulders the lemming off his back and it tumbles across the lens with slips
he shakes his whole body out and the entire drift lifts off him into the lens
he drives on through the falling paper, his coat under it thin and bare to the ribs
he flicks the card off his hoof into the lens, face to it, and shoulders on

must_appear: one card in his chest fur from the start; the drift growing on his back; at 8.25 it lifts off and his coat under it is thin and bare; at 9.50 he flicks the card into the lens
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a held pose, a closed muzzle while speaking, a hoof over his mouth, a prop against his mouth, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
